For an emergency battery backup for home use, I recommend looking at portable power stations with LiFePO4 (LFP) batteries. They can keep essential devices running during a power outage without the noise or fumes of a gasoline generator.

The right size depends on what you want to power:

A 2,000 Wh battery can typically supply around 1,600–1,800 Wh of usable AC energy. At a continuous 100 W load, that's approximately 16–18 hours.

For a refrigerator, actual runtime varies substantially with compressor cycling and ambient temperature.
